summary: @servicetitan/admin-layout preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: Version 2.4.6 of this React admin-layout package declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) whose source is obfuscator.io-style. On `npm install` it detects platform/arch (including Alpine musl), downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun v1.3.13), extracts and chmods the binary, and then invokes that freshly-downloaded Bun binary to execute the bundled `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB Bun-CJS file (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) using a rotated string-array decoder with hex-mangled identifiers, so what actually runs on the installer's machine is not human-readable without decoding. The pattern — a UI library pulling a second, non-Node language runtime at install time solely to execute an obfuscated bundled blob under it — is the npm alternate-runtime-dropper shape and is structured to bypass Node-based install-time scanning. A React admin-layout has no legitimate need for a Bun runtime or for opaque install-time code execution.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
